maintenance_led.reason: Sells newly designed apparel (Donna Karan, DKNY, Karl Lagerfeld, Marc Jacobs, Vilebrequin) to retailers and consumers; first-time purchases, not repair or replacement.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are department stores, retailers and consumers buying fashion apparel; no government payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling licensed and owned brands, with occasional brand acquisitions like Vilebrequin and Karl Lagerfeld, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Fashion apparel and accessories sold to retailers and consumers; retailers can switch brands or suppliers easily, with no regulatory or operational disruption.
